Definition: from G4350; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin:--offence.
BiblicalUsage: Proskope means an occasion of stumbling, an offence given. It appears once, in Paul's defence of his ministry: giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a blameless ministry is not a ministry without enemies, but a ministry that gives them nothing true to blame.
